name: s-bites-render
description: Pins the HyperFrames CLI the render adapter shells out to. Not an application package -- the Python pipeline is the application. Pinned because an unpinned `npx hyperframes` re-resolved the CLI on every call (0.8.10 -> 0.8.12 -> 0.8.15 across three tasks) and version drift produced non-deterministic `check` results (D96).
